0.heading: Overview
refs: Psa 124:1 , The church blesses God for a miraculous deliverance.
It is uncertain what the particular deliverance was which is celebrated in this Psalm. Some refer it to the deliverance of Hezekiah from Sennacherib
and others to the return from the Babylonian captivity
while Dr. A. Clarke refers it to that of the Jews from the massacre intended by Haman.
0.body:
Psa 124:1 , The church blesses God for a miraculous deliverance.
It is uncertain what the particular deliverance was which is celebrated in this Psalm. Some refer it to the deliverance of Hezekiah from Sennacherib; and others to the return from the Babylonian captivity; while Dr. A. Clarke refers it to that of the Jews from the massacre intended by Haman.
